visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Move the new Calls into a Factory
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The choice between the classes is made with an if / else right in main, and would be repeated everywhere a notifier is needed. Put it in a factory method. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: With a factory, main no longer knows which classes exist. Adding a push-notification class means changing only the factory, not every place that creates a notifier.
